title: The thirteen interval identity colours
form: a wide arched window of layered glass whose upper wall carries a graduated row of thirteen tiny translucent jewel-beads in neutral warm glass, one for each rung of a ladder

title: The Week 2 keyboard window, B3 to C5
form: a long low keyboard-shaped terrace window: a wide shallow arch with fine vertical glass ribbing along its lower rim like soft piano resonance, no keys drawn

title: Reading a two-lane timeline
form: a horizontal river-ribbon frame: two parallel luminous glass currents flowing left to right along the top and bottom walls, converging gently at the ends

title: Counting letters is not counting semitones
form: a pair of overlapping glass rings, one counting by smooth even beads and one by fine tick-like facets, sharing a gentle overlap

title: Four motion glyphs
form: a lens-shaped (vesica) frame of four small glass petals arranged at the corners, each petal tilting a different direction (up, down, apart, together) as pure shapes

title: What stayed, what changed
form: a rounded scroll frame with one edge of calm unchanged glass and the opposite edge of shifting layered glass, as a visible contrast of stayed versus changed

title: Plogger lens for the four named pairs
form: a wide stained-glass triptych arch with three softly lit panes in a row, each a different luminous texture (outline, shadow, graded fill), no symbols

title: Plogger lens for the 2A pairs
form: a wide stained-glass pair of arches, left and right, each with three softly lit panes of different texture, joined by a slim bridge

title: Pair badges used in Week 2
form: a garland frame of small paired glass lozenges along the top and bottom, like a row of two-note pair badges, in neutral warm glass

title: How to read our pictures
form: an open-book-shaped glass frame, two pages curving from a central luminous spine, with quiet pages for reading instructions

title: The Week 2 path: three lessons
form: a long path-like ribbon of three linked glass lanterns in a row connected by a thin glowing stem, the middle lantern slightly larger

title: Week 1 used C3; Week 2 starts at C4
form: two stacked glass terraces, a lower one and an upper one, offset by a gentle step, like two octaves of the same landscape

title: From a note to harmony
form: an ascending glass staircase of three broad luminous steps rising left to right (from one note to two to a whole sound), framing a wide clearing

title: Three lessons in miniature
form: three small linked glass medallions side by side, each a miniature of a lesson, joined by a flowing garland, with a calm wide clearing in the centre

title: Two notes, two voices: C4 and E4
form: two overlapping luminous glass discs, one deeper and one lighter, like two independent voices standing together, joined at a soft shared overlap

title: Count the letters: C D E and E F G
form: a trio of three soft glass beads strung on a fine arc above the clearing, counting 1-2-3, framed by a delicate oval halo

title: Count the semitones: every key counts
form: a chain of small glass beads of alternating sizes strung around an oval halo, as if counting every key one step at a time

title: Same letters, different size: major and minor third
form: two separate wide oval medallions side by side joined by a slim glass bridge; the left a little wider than the right, thin layered halos

title: One voice moves: a major third becomes a perfect fourth
form: a single oval halo whose right edge grows an arc-shaped glass petal that shifts outward, suggesting one side moving while the other stays

title: The foundation can travel
form: a wide travelling frame: three oval glass halos in a row of decreasing opacity like the same shape carried along to new places, linked by a thread

title: Three changes from one beginning
form: three petal-like glass fans radiating from one shared base at the bottom centre, each fan opening a different amount, framing a clearing

title: Your keyboard sheet: build, then change
form: a worksheet-like but soft glass frame: a wide rounded window with quiet bands for your own marks, thin delicate corner filigree, calm and open

title: One after another, and together
form: two interlinked glass rings, one set slightly in front of the other, like notes heard one after another and together

title: The foundation moves: E4 and G4, a minor third
form: a single oval halo with a smaller companion halo beside it, the pair slightly narrower than a major-third pair, joined by a short bridge

title: Two paths through time
form: two parallel flowing glass ribbons running left to right through time, drifting apart and together, framing a wide clearing between them

title: Before we name it: two journeys
form: two curved glass journey paths from the left edge to the right edge, one rising, one falling, crossing nowhere, framing a clearing

title: Three families of motion, with exact examples
form: a four-quadrant glass window of four petal-shaped panes in a 2 by 2 arrangement, each petal tilting a different way, with a calm clearing in the centre of each pane region

title: Change 1: only the upper voice rises
form: a wide arch where only the upper right keystone glows and lifts, the rest still: an upper voice that alone rises

title: Change 2: only the lower voice falls
form: a wide arch where only the lower left base glows and sinks, the rest still: a lower voice that alone falls

title: Change 3: only the lower voice rises
form: a wide arch where only the lower left base glows and lifts upward, the rest still: a lower voice that alone rises

title: Change 4: moving apart, B3 and F4, a diminished fifth
form: two glass arcs opening outward like a fan from the centre bottom, spreading wide to the left and right: voices moving apart

title: Change 5: both rise, a major third becomes a minor third
form: two parallel glass ribbons both climbing to the upper right, the upper one climbing by a smaller step: both rise

title: The five changes, all from C4 + E4
form: a wide arched colonnade of five small glass bays side by side, each a slightly different gesture, joined by a thin lintel

title: Similar, and strict parallel
form: two separate neighbouring glass frames: the left one a pair of rising ribbons of unequal climb, the right one a pair of strictly equal rails visibly set apart by a wider gap and cooler glass

title: A two-voice path in four stages
form: a rising set of four glass steps from left to right, stage by stage, each step a lit pane framing the clearing

title: Your two-voice path sheet
form: a calm four-bay glass frame with empty quiet pane areas for the learner to fill, thin soft filigree edging

title: Contrary motion, together: the voices move toward each other
form: two glass arcs converging toward the centre from left and right like arms drawing together, with a luminous meeting point at the bottom

title: Contrary motion, together: B3 + F4 to C4 + E4
form: two glass arcs converging toward the centre from both sides, meeting at a soft luminous knot, framing a clearing above

title: Two kinds of words: along a path, up a stage
form: a split frame: the left half a flowing horizontal ribbon (along a path), the right half a stack of small steps (up a stage), joined by a bridge

title: The tritone family: B3–F4 beside the Palette card C4–F♯4
form: two tall glass medallions side by side, the left a little ornate and the right a little plainer, connected by a narrow bridge, for two cousins of one family

title: Two 36-second sketches: same upper line, different lower line
form: two wide horizontal river bands stacked above each other, the upper band a calm continuous current and the lower a changing current, framing a clearing

title: Version A: one voice holds the landscape
form: a long horizontal glass band where one calm lower current holds steady like a landscape held still, with fine ripples along the lower rim

title: Version B: the landscape begins to travel
form: a long horizontal glass band whose lower current begins to bend and travel, rippling and shifting hue-neutral layers along the rim

title: Same melody, one moment different: A above B
form: two stacked long glass bands, an upper and a lower, identical on top and subtly different below, sharing a slim bridge at the right

title: Three snapshots: what stayed, what changed
form: a row of three small glass lanterns of equal size on a thin arc, each lit identically on top and differently below

title: Four words: voice, vertical interval, voice leading, counterpoint
form: four small round glass seals arranged in a gentle arc across the top of the clearing, each a different luminous texture, connected by a thread

title: Plan your miniature: two blank timelines
form: two long empty glass bands stacked, calm and open, for the learner to plan on, with delicate filigree only at the far ends

title: What changes, and your response
form: a wide two-column glass frame, a left window for what changes and a right window for your response, joined by a small bridge

title: Week 2 in three anchors
form: three anchor-like glass keystones in an arch, rising from low to high, framing a wide clearing for the three anchors of the week

title: The truth check: the lower voice moves while the upper rests
form: a wide horizontal glass band with a calm resting upper line and a moving lower line, a soft glow marking the rest, framing a clearing
